children: Profound Medical reported preliminary unaudited revenue for Q3 2026 of $9.8 million to $10.0 million, a year-over-year increase of about 85%–89% and roughly 45%–47% above Bloomberg consensus. The company said sequential revenue rose roughly 292%–300% versus Q2 2026, with gross margin again expected to exceed 70%. Profound Medical plans to release full Q3 results after market close on November 5, 2026, and will host a conference call that day.
Approximately 45% to 47% above the Bloomberg mean analyst consensus of $6.78 million.
Company cited strong commercial momentum across its installed base and new customer accounts driving the revenue increase.
Management emphasized increased utilization of installed systems as a contributor to higher quarterly revenue.
Ongoing commercial activities support expansion of the company’s flagship TULSA-PRO and Sonalleve MRI-guided therapy platforms.
Profound continues to pursue broader clinical applications and market adoption for its MRI-guided, incision-free therapies.

title: Profound Medical: Q3 2026 preliminary revenue $9.8M–$10.0M, gross margin >70%
